verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no SOC 2 or other compliance attestations, no trust center or audit-report access, no data-handling or residency policies, and no datacenter tier information. The only related items describe security architecture: bare-metal clusters without a hypervisor, DPU isolation, per-cluster VPCs, and API token authentication. These are adjacent features, not a way to verify the provider's compliance posture, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify the provider's security and compliance posture (SOC 2, data handling, datacenter tiers) before putting proprietary models on it
